videos.script: A sale now crosses two services: the box office, and payments, which charges the card. Lesson 7's metrics say a sale is slow; they cannot say where. {{two}} OpenTelemetry is one way of recording that, the same in every language, and independent of where the data ends up. {{standard}} Each service creates spans, sends them in batches to a Collector, and the Collector hands them to Jaeger. {{pipeline}} The first sale's trace: sixty eight milliseconds, and thirty eight of them spent charging the card. {{trace}} What holds two services in one trace is one header, four fields long. {{header}} The same id goes into every log line, so a line of log leads to its trace. {{logs}} And at real traffic you keep only some traces. Two hundred reads, twenty two traces kept, and what that choice cannot see. {{sampling}}
